card.product_version_note: No product refresh noted on the issuer page as of 2026-10-28. Lyft 5x total points promotion runs through 2027-09-30; DoorDash DashPass offer requires activation by 2027-12-31. Issuer page notes that starting 2026-10-01 Ultimate Rewards points transfer to World of Hyatt at a 4:3 ratio (1,000 points become 750). benefits.name: New cardmember bonus: 100,000 bonus points
benefits.period_note: Earn 100,000 bonus points after spending $8,000 on purchases in the first 3 months after account opening. Bonus posts 6 to 8 weeks after qualifying. This is the offer visible on the issuer page on 2026-10-28; the offer that applies to a recently approved account is the one shown at the time of application, so the owner should confirm the threshold and window on the approval terms. The page states a spend threshold ($8,000) and a window (3 months from account opening).
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Spend $8,000 on purchases within 3 months of account opening. Page states the bonus may be unavailable to applicants who have ever held this card.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.period_note: Up to $1,000 per claim; maximum of 3 claims in a 12-month period; $100 deductible per claim.
benefits.enrollment_note: Pay the monthly cell phone bill with the card to be covered.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Covers theft or damage of phones listed on the monthly cell phone bill when that bill is paid with the card. Up to $1,000 per claim, 3 claims per 12-month period, $100 deductible per claim.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation/Interruption Insurance
benefits.period_note: Up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Pre-paid, non-refundable passenger fares and other covered travel expenses paid with the card, when the trip is cancelled or cut short by a covered situation such as sickness or severe weather.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. amount_cents holds the per-traveler cap; the per-trip cap is $10,000.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver (primary for business rentals)
benefits.period_note: Per rental. Coverage is primary when renting for business purposes.
benefits.enrollment_note: Decline the rental company's collision insurance and charge the entire rental to the card.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Reimburses up to $60,000 for theft and collision damage on most rental vehicles with an MSRP of $125,000 or less. Primary when renting for business purposes.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.period_note: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase (90 days for New York residents). Up to $10,000 per item. The product page does not state a per-account annual maximum.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible new purchases made with the card, against damage or theft.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. Per-item cap recorded; per-account cap not stated on the page.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.period_note: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less by one additional year, up to four years from the purchase date.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible items purchased with the card that carry a U.S. manufacturer warranty of three years or less.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. The product page does not state a dollar cap for this benefit.

benefits.name: Employee cards at no additional cost
benefits.period_note: Employee cards are offered at no additional cost for the life of the account.
benefits.enrollment_note: Request employee cards through Chase; individual spending limits can be set per employee card.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Employee card purchases earn rewards on the primary account. The page does not state a maximum number of employee cards.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.period_note: Applies to all purchases made outside the United States for the life of the account.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.name: DoorDash DashPass complimentary membership (12 months minimum) with up to $10 monthly off non-restaurant orders
benefits.period_note: Complimentary DashPass for at least 12 months when activated by 2027-12-31; includes $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees, plus up to $10 monthly off non-restaurant DoorDash orders. The page does not say whether unused monthly amounts roll over.
benefits.enrollment_note: Activate DashPass with the card by 2027-12-31.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: DoorDash orders while DashPass is active with the card; the $10 monthly discount applies to non-restaurant orders.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. end_date is the activation deadline stated on the page, not necessarily the end of the membership.
